player.name: LeBron James

player.archetype: The King, versatile greatness, longevity personified

figure.name: King David
figure.attributeDescription: wearing simple golden crown of ancient Israel on his head, leather shepherd's sling with smooth river stones
figure.clothing: royal robes in purple and blue over simple tunic, ancient Israelite style NOT medieval
figure.physicalDescription: young and handsome, RUDDY complexion with reddish hair (as described in 1 Samuel 16:12), beautiful eyes, strong shepherd's build
figure.archetype: The Shepherd King, rose from nothing to greatest ruler

connection.thematic: Both rose from humble beginnings to become the undisputed king of their domain
connection.narrative: From Akron to the throne. From shepherd to king. Built different.
connection.relationship: Self-made kings who earned their crowns

scripture.english: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren; and the spirit of the LORD came mightily upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.
